messages:
Priya (sec): heads up — storage-monitor flagged an unencrypted DB snapshot in prod S3 from last night. unsure which job wrote it.
Sam (sre): ugh. link?
Priya (sec): s3://redwood-backups/prod/db-snap-2026-03-19-03.tar.gz — CloudTrail shows PutObject without SSE headers.
enc-bot: alert: storage-monitor detected put_object without SSE - snapshot db-snap-2026-03-19-03.tar.gz - eventTime=2026-03-19T03:12:21Z - principal=arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/backup-runner/instance-abc123
Marta (eng-security): likely backup-runner role lost kms permissions after the IAM cleanup last week. can someone confirm the role policies?
Liu (infra): checking now. I see backup-runner has S3:PutObject but missing kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt for CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01.
Sam (sre): that would allow S3 to accept plaintext uploads. we should treat this as a P1 for remediation and triage.
Priya (sec): agreed. immediate actions: 1) ensure backlog of snapshots flagged and quarantine 2) update role policy + key grants 3) audit & alert rules 4) re-encrypt or destroy unencrypted copy if necessary.
Liu (infra): quick fix IAM patch I'm testing locally:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey",
        "kms:ReEncrypt*"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"
    }
  ]
}
```
Marta (eng-security): also add a key policy or grant from the CMK so the role is explicitly allowed by the key — relying on IAM only is brittle. Key policy snippet to attach:
```json
{
  "Sid": "Allow backup-runner",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/backup-runner/" },
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:ReEncrypt*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Sam (sre): parallel change: enforce S3-side config to require SSE-KMS on bucket. bucket policy condition example:
```json
{
  "Sid": "RequireSSEKMS",
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-backups/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
  }
}
```
Priya (sec): good — defense in depth: IAM + KMS key policy + bucket enforcement.
Marta (eng-security): audit logging: add CloudWatch metric filter for CloudTrail PutObject events where requestParameters.xAmzServerSideEncryption is null/absent. alert to #incidents.
enc-bot: sample CloudWatch filter: {($.eventName = "PutObject") && !($.requestParameters.xAmzServerSideEncryption)}
Liu (infra): we should also add an alert when KMS DENY errors appear in logs (kms:AccessDenied on GenerateDataKey). that would catch misconfigured permissions before plaintext upload.
Sam (sre): re-encryption plan: snapshot is 120GB. options: 1) copy server-side with SSE-KMS (aws s3 cp --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id <arn> s3://src s3://dst) 2) if copy not possible, restore to temp RDS, export with SSE enabled then replace object. runbook decision?
Priya (sec): prefer server-side copy into locked bucket with retention 30d but mark for forensic snapshot. we need org sign-off if customer data. For now assume internal PII-not-present.
Marta (eng-security): also update runbooks: include postmortem checklist: timeline, affected objects, principal, whether KMS grants were changed, list of remediated snapshots, and customer notification decision tree.
Liu (infra): I'm rolling the IAM + key policy patch to staging now. will run a dry-run alert rule against last 7 days to surface any other plaintext uploads.
Sam (sre): I'll create a quick Lambda that scans recent PutObject CloudTrail events and auto-tags unencrypted objects so we can quarantine them.
Priya (sec): owners + SLAs: infra to push IAM/key fix in 1h, Sam to deploy scanner in 2h, Marta to update runbook + incident ticket owner. Please post status updates.
Sam (sre): noted. starting scanner dev now.
Liu (infra): IAM patch applied to staging, testing KMS generateDataKey success. will promote in 45m.
Marta (eng-security): I'll draft incident summary and include recommended RBAC changes for product teams (backup-runner, snapshot-trigger, adhoc-backups).
Priya (sec): final ask — block future plaintext uploads at the S3 control plane (bucket policy) before we rely on role fixes. schedule a short blast window to apply and monitor. :thumbsup:
Sam (sre): ack. tagging @oncall for monitoring during change window.
enc-bot: follow-up: created ticket INC-2026-041 - Unencrypted snapshot detected - assigned to infra/sre/sec - timeline created.
